items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: Yeah, I started from 32. Worked with him 17 years.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, on the piano. And you mentioned you'd worked with him, was it, for 17 years?

Yeah, I started from 32. Worked with him 17 years. 17 years. Now this is a boy named Reece Corbett. He's not here, he lives in California, and I think he's stopped playing music a good number of years.
Tenor sax, I believe he has.
